{
  "overview": "This project enhances the existing URL shortener service by introducing basic click analytics and fixing a critical issue where expired links were incorrectly redirecting due to caching. For every successful redirect, the service will now asynchronously record the timestamp, referrer host, and a coarse user-agent family. A new API endpoint, `/api/v1/links/{code}/stats`, is added to provide aggregated click statistics, including total clicks, the last click time, and daily counts for the past 7 days. The core redirect functionality is modified to store full link metadata in the cache, enabling an explicit check for link expiration on every request, thus ensuring that expired links consistently return an HTTP 410 Gone status, even when cached. Performance of the redirect path is maintained by processing analytics asynchronously.",
  "components": [
    {
      "name": "Click",

      "files": ["src/main/java/io/github/marishasahay/shortener/click/Click.java"]

    {

    {

    {
      "name": "ClickConfiguration",

    {

  "openApiYaml": "openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: URL Shortener API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    Creates short links and redirects short codes to their target URLs.

    All errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`). `type` is omitted
    when it is `about:blank`; `instance` is the request path. Operational endpoints
    (`/actuator/health`, `/actuator/info`, `/actuator/metrics`) are not part of this contract.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8080

paths:
  /api/v1/links:
    post:
      operationId: createLink
      summary: Create a short link
      description: |
        Creates a link with a random 7-character base62 code, or with `customAlias` as the code.
        Rate limited per client IP (default 20 requests per minute, token bucket).
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateLinkRequest'
            examples:
              generated:
                value:
                  url: https://example.com/some/long/path
              customAliasWithExpiry:
                value:
                  url: https://example.com/launch
                  customAlias: launch-2026
                  expiresAt: '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Link created.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: Absolute URL of the link's metadata resource (`{baseUrl}/api/v1/links/{code}`).
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/AliasConflict'
        '415':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaType'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /api/v1/links/{code}:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: The short code.
        schema:
          type: string
    get:
      operationId: getLink
      summary: Get link metadata
      description: Returns the link, including expired links. Deleted links are not found.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The link.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkResponse'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'
    delete:
      operationId: deleteLink
      summary: Delete a link
      description: |
        Soft-deletes the link and evicts it from the redirect cache. The code is never reused:
        creating a link with the same alias afterwards returns 409.
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Link deleted.
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /api/v1/links/{code}/stats:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: The short code.
        schema:
          type: string
    get:
      operationId: getLinkStats
      summary: Get link click statistics
      description: Returns total clicks, last click timestamp, and daily click counts for the last 7 days.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Link statistics.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkStatsResponse'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /{code}:
    parameters:
      - name: code
        in: path
        required: true
        description: |
          The short code. Paths that do not match the pattern are not routed to this operation
          and return 404.
        schema:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
    get:
      operationId: redirect
      summary: Redirect to the target URL
      description: |
        Responds with `302 Found` (not 301) and `Cache-Control: no-store`, so browsers do not
        cache the redirect and every visit reaches the service.
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Redirect to the target URL.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: The target URL.
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
            Cache-Control:
              description: Always `no-store`.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-store
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '410':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Gone'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

components:
  schemas:
    CreateLinkRequest:
      type: object
      required: [url]
      properties:
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          maxLength: 2048
          description: |
            Absolute `http` or `https` URL with a host. Rejected (400) if it contains user info
            (e.g. `https://bank.com@evil.com`), points at the shortener's own host, or is longer
            than 2048 characters. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.
          examples: ['https://example.com/some/long/path']
        customAlias:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
          description: |
            Optional code to use instead of a generated one. Reserved words (case-insensitive):
            api, actuator, health, admin, static, assets, public, login, logout, error, favicon,
            robots, metrics, info, docs, swagger, openapi, www.
          examples: [launch-2026]
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Optional ISO-8601 instant; must be in the future. Stored at microsecond precision.
          examples: ['2026-12-31T23:59:59Z']

    LinkResponse:
      type: object
      required: [code, shortUrl, targetUrl, createdAt, expiresAt]
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,32}$'
          examples: [aZ3kP9q]
        shortUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: '`{baseUrl}/{code}`'
          examples: ['http://localhost:8080/aZ3kP9q']
        targetUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          examples: ['https://example.com/some/long/path']
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          examples: ['2026-01-01T00:00:00Z']
        expiresAt:
          type: [string, 'null']
          format: date-time
          description: '`null` when the link never expires.'
          examples: [null]

    LinkStatsResponse:
      type: object
      required: [totalClicks, dailyCounts]
      properties:
        totalClicks:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Total number of successful redirects for this link.
          minimum: 0
          examples: [123]
        lastClickAt:
          type: [string, 'null']
          format: date-time
          description: ISO-8601 instant of the most recent click. `null` if no clicks.
          examples: ['2023-10-27T10:30:00Z', null]
        dailyCounts:
          type: array
          description: Daily click counts for the last 7 full days, in UTC.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/DailyClickCount'
          minItems: 7
          maxItems: 7

    DailyClickCount:
      type: object
      required: [date, count]
      properties:
        date:
          type: string
          format: date
          description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC).
          examples: ['2023-10-27']
        count:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Number of clicks on this date.
          minimum: 0
          examples: [5]

    ProblemDetail:
      type: object
      description: RFC 9457 problem document.
      required: [title, status, instance]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
          description: Omitted when `about:blank`.
        title:
          type: string
          description: |
            Short summary. Application errors use: `Invalid request`, `Link not found`,
            `Link expired`, `Alias already in use`, `Too many requests`,
            `Short code generation failed`, `Internal server error`. Framework errors (e.g.
            malformed JSON, unsupported media type) use the HTTP reason phrase.
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
          description: The request path.
        errors:
          type: array
          description: Present on `Invalid request` (400) problems.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/FieldViolation'

    FieldViolation:
      type: object
      required: [field, message]
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          examples: [url]
        message:
          type: string
          examples: [must not be blank]

  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: |
        Invalid request: bean validation failure (missing `url`), target URL or alias policy
        violation, expiry not in the future, or malformed / unparseable JSON.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          examples:
            validation:
              value:
                title: Invalid request
                status: 400
                detail: Request validation failed
                instance: /api/v1/links
                errors:
                  - field: url
                    message: must not be blank
            policy:
              value:
                title: Invalid request
                status: 400
                detail: url must not contain user info
                instance: /api/v1/links
                errors:
                  - field: url
                    message: must not contain user info
            malformedJson:
              value:
                title: Bad Request
                status: 400
                detail: Failed to read request
                instance: /api/v1/links
    NotFound:
      description: No active link exists for the code (never created, or deleted).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Link not found
            status: 404
            detail: No link exists for code 'aZ3kP9q'
            instance: /aZ3kP9q
    Gone:
      description: The link exists but has expired.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Link expired
            status: 410
            detail: The link for code 'aZ3kP9q' has expired
            instance: /aZ3kP9q
    AliasConflict:
      description: The custom alias is already in use (including by a deleted link).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Alias already in use
            status: 409
            detail: The alias 'launch-2026' is already in use
            instance: /api/v1/links
    UnsupportedMediaType:
      description: The request body is not `application/json`.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    TooManyRequests:
      description: The client exceeded the link-creation rate limit.
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          description: Seconds until the next request will be accepted (at least 1).
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
          example:
            title: Too many requests
            status: 429
            detail: Rate limit exceeded; retry after 3 seconds
            instance: /api/v1/links
    InternalServerError:
      description: |
        Unexpected failure, or no unique code could be generated within 5 attempts
        (`Short code generation failed`).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
",
  "dataModel": "CREATE TABLE clicks (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    link_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    clicked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
    referrer_host VARCHAR(255),
    user_agent_family VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_link
        FOREIGN KEY (link_id)
        REFERENCES links (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX idx_clicks_link_id ON clicks (link_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_clicks_clicked_at ON clicks (clicked_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_clicks_link_id_clicked_at ON clicks (link_id, clicked_at DESC);",
  "decisions": [
    {
      "title": "Asynchronous Click Recording",
      "choice": "Implement click recording asynchronously using Spring's `@Async` with a `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor` configured with a bounded queue.",
      "rationale": "This choice directly addresses NFR-1 by decoupling click recording from the critical redirect path, ensuring minimal latency impact on redirects. A `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor` with a bounded queue prevents unbounded memory growth under high load, aligning with the 'best effort' principle for analytics data. If the queue is full, the click event will be logged as an error and dropped, prioritizing redirect performance over analytics completeness.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Synchronous recording: Rejected due to NFR-1 (performance impact).",
        "External Message Queue (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ): Rejected for simplicity and added operational overhead for basic analytics. While more robust for high-volume, guaranteed delivery, it's considered overkill for the current requirements and 'best effort' nature."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "User-Agent Parsing Library",
      "choice": "Use the `ua-parser-java` library for determining the coarse user-agent family.",
      "rationale": "This choice addresses Q-2 by providing a well-maintained, lightweight solution for user-agent classification. It reduces custom regex complexity and improves accuracy compared to simpler heuristics, ensuring reasonable accuracy and maintainability.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Custom regex-based logic: Rejected due to complexity, maintenance burden, and potential for inaccuracies as user-agent strings evolve.",
        "Simpler heuristics (e.g., checking for 'bot' substring): Rejected as it would be less accurate and robust than a dedicated library."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Expired Link Handling with Cache",
      "choice": "Modify `LinkResolver` to store full `Link` objects (containing `expiresAt`) in the Caffeine cache. On every `resolve` call, explicitly check the `expiresAt` field of the cached `Link` object against the current time.",
      "rationale": "This choice directly addresses FR-3 and NFR-4 by ensuring that expired links consistently return HTTP 410 Gone, even when present in the cache. It centralizes the expiration logic within the `LinkResolver`, making it robust and easy to reason about. The existing `Cache-Control: no-store` header on redirects means browsers won't cache the redirect itself, but the service's internal cache still needs this explicit check.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Cache-aside with TTL matching `expiresAt`: Rejected because `expiresAt` can be dynamic and setting individual TTLs for each cache entry based on `expiresAt` can be complex and less reliable than an explicit check, especially if `expiresAt` is updated or is null (never expires).",
        "Proactive cache invalidation on expiry: Rejected due to complexity. Requires a background job to scan for expired links and invalidate cache entries, which adds latency to the 410 response (NFR-4 requires within 1 minute) and introduces potential race conditions. An explicit check is simpler and more reliable."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Daily Click Count Time Zone",
      "choice": "Aggregate daily click counts using UTC for daily boundaries.",
      "rationale": "This choice addresses Q-4 by providing a consistent, unambiguous global standard for time-series data. It simplifies analysis and avoids issues with daylight saving changes or server time zone configurations, ensuring data integrity and ease of interpretation.",
      "alternatives": [
        "Server's local time zone: Rejected due to inconsistency across different deployment environments and potential for confusion with daylight saving.",
        "Client's requested time zone: Rejected due to added complexity for the API (requiring a time zone header) and potential for inconsistent data if different clients request different time zones."
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Click Data Retention",
      "choice": "Store raw click events in the `clicks` table indefinitely for now, but monitor storage growth. If storage becomes an issue, implement a policy to archive or purge raw click records older than 90 days, while retaining aggregated daily counts for longer periods (e.g., 1 year or indefinitely).",
      "rationale": "This choice balances the immediate need for detailed analytics with potential future storage cost concerns (Risk: Storage cost increase). NFR-3 only requires 7 days of *daily counts*, not raw clicks. This approach provides flexibility to adapt to future analytical requirements while having a plan for managing data volume.",
      "alternatives": [
        "No retention policy: Rejected as it leads to unbounded storage growth and potential performance degradation over time.",
        "Immediate aggregation and discard of raw clicks: Rejected as it limits future analytical capabilities (e.g., hourly trends, specific referrer analysis beyond host) if requirements evolve."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Performance degradation of the redirect service due to synchronous analytics recording: Mitigated by implementing click recording as an asynchronous operation using Spring's @Async with a dedicated, bounded ThreadPoolTaskExecutor, decoupling it from the critical redirect path. P99 latency of GET /{code} will be closely monitored.",
    "Data integrity issues with click counts or timestamps: Mitigated by using robust JDBC operations for transactional writes for click recording. For asynchronous processing, Spring's default error handling for @Async methods will be relied upon, with monitoring for any failures. Data consistency will be regularly audited.",
    "Security vulnerability due to user-agent parsing library: Mitigated by choosing 'ua-parser-java', a well-vetted and actively maintained third-party library. Code reviews will focus on input sanitization and error handling around user-agent processing, and the library will be kept updated.",
    "Cache invalidation logic for expired links is complex and introduces new bugs: Mitigated by modifying the LinkResolver to store full 'Link' objects in the Caffeine cache and explicitly checking the 'expiresAt' field of the cached 'Link' object on every request. This simplifies the cache logic by centralizing the expiry check. Thorough unit and integration tests will cover edge cases.",
    "Storage cost increase due to click data: Mitigated by monitoring storage growth for the 'clicks' table. If necessary, a future iteration will implement data archiving or purging policies for older, raw click records, retaining only aggregated daily counts for long-term trends."
  ]
}
